# @webry/clone

_A deno cli to clone a repo anonymously while preserving commit & file type statistics. 👥_

</div>

&nbsp;

## What it does

Files and code are randomly generated and no real data is copied.

## How to install it

```bash
deno install --global --allow-run="git" --allow-env --allow-read --allow-write --name webry-clone jsr:@webry/clone
```

## How to use it

```bash
webry-clone -f ./from-gitlab-repo -t ./to-github-repo
```
